correctness.rationale: PASS: The universal strip with glide-reflection deck transformation is convex, so the squared geodesic is the minimum of two parity-image squared lengths. For independent uniform longitudinal coordinates, |x-x'| has triangular density, and transverse product (y/w)(y'/w) has density -1/2 log|z|. Integrating the piecewise positive-part expression yields both rational/log formulas, including exactly A=1. A=1 expansion has leading mismatch (A-1)^4/48. For F(A)=Phi(A)/sqrt(A), derivative has sign - for A<1, and h(A)/(144 A^(5/2)) for A>1 with h=3A^2-24A+18log A+21, h'=6(A-1)(A-3)/A, giving one unique global min >3. Independent deterministic high-precision integration at five aspect ratios matched expressions. No extrinsic embedding assumption.
